claim: The repo reports that Shadow of War's Nemesis ('Faction') logic runs on one game thread, dispatches every event through HandleFactionEventAction (RVA 40C304), and draws outcomes from one global 64-bit LCG.
evidence: README: LCG state at RVA 2A25C88; RollResurrection 6DBD4C uses RandomFloat; notes conclude a client must never run these rolls.

sources.location: ## How the game works (for co-op), Nemesis system / Randomness

game_build_compatibility: Repo-reported for Steam app 356190 build 3095001, ShadowOfWar.exe 1.0.8874.0, SHA-256 ed0d95cabb033cd66aaa99d699374881846c3cb03ec345f1123d82d45e0bdaef; not checked against our install.
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Repo claims verified by its author in the running game; not verified by us. Using these RVAs on a different build would be wrong. Event-stream vs Faction.Save/Load sync is undecided in the repo.
next_experiment: Hypothesis for Phase 2: host-side Nemesis event stream (results only) plus join-time Faction.Save/Load snapshot; validate only after build identity matches.
